newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says has no special info on US rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says has no special info on US rates.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday he had not divulged confidential information in commenting about the U.S. inflationary outlook during a controversial media briefing last week.
"I am not possessed of any special knowledge on what will happen to monetary policy in the United States," Costello told parliament.
"It should be entirely clear that comments that I make should not be understood as relying on special knowledge."
But Costello said he accepted criticism of his remarks and would not make similar comments again.
"I accept the criticism that one should not comment on those conditions and I certainly won't be doing that further," Costello said.
Costello, after a private meeting with U.S. Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan, told reporters the U.S. interest rate scene was unlikely to change.
His comments moved financial markets around the world.
Costello originally denied making the comments, until he was forced to back down after a journalist released a tape of the briefing.
